function.name: find_patient_by_phone
function.description: Look up an existing patient by phone number. Call this silently EVERY time you learn a phone number: once right after the greeting with no arguments (which uses the caller's own number), and again passing any phone number the caller speaks aloud. Use it to offer an update instead of creating a duplicate record. If caller_id_available is false, the caller's number is unknown and must be asked for.

phone_number.description: Optional. Omit this to look up the number the caller is dialing from, which is the normal case. Only pass a value if the caller explicitly gives a different number.

function.name: register_patient
function.description: Save a new patient registration. Only call this AFTER reading all collected information back to the caller and getting their confirmation. If the result contains field errors, re-ask the caller for only those specific fields and call again.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in MM/DD/YYYY format. Must be in the past.

phone_number.description: Omit unless the caller explicitly asked for a different number on file — their calling number is used automatically. Never guess or invent this value.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state abbreviation, e.g. CA.

email.description: Optional. Only include if the caller provided it.

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Update an existing patient record. Use this when find_patient_by_phone found a record and the caller confirmed they want to update rather than register again. Only include the fields the caller wants to change.

function.name: get_current_time
function.description: Get the clinic's current local date and time, and whether the clinic is open right now. Call this whenever the caller asks what time or day it is, or whether the clinic is open. You have no internal clock, so NEVER state a time without calling this first.

function.name: list_appointment_slots
function.description: Get real open appointment slots. Call this before offering any appointment time. Offer two or three of the returned slots to the caller using their `spoken` text. NEVER invent or guess an appointment time.

limit.description: How many slots to fetch. Default 4.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book an appointment for an already-registered patient. Pass the exact slot_id string returned by list_appointment_slots -- never a time you composed yourself. Requires the patient_id returned by register_patient.

slot_id.description: The exact slot_id string from list_appointment_slots, e.g. 2026-08-21T14:30.

reason.description: Optional short reason for the visit.
